title: Transfers
subtitle: Send, top up, or withdraw for the active organization. Large outbound amounts may require dual-control approval.

send.title: Send money
send.subtitleAdmin: Transfer from any wallet to another account number. Large spends may need dual-control approval.
send.subtitleOrg: Transfer from an organization wallet. Amounts at or above the dual-control threshold need another member to approve.

addFunds.title: Add funds
addFunds.subtitleAdmin: Deposit into any wallet in the system.
addFunds.subtitleOrg: Deposit into a wallet in the active organization.

withdraw.title: Withdraw funds
withdraw.subtitleAdmin: Move money out of any wallet. Large withdrawals may need dual-control approval.
withdraw.subtitleOrg: Move money out of an organization wallet. Large amounts need another member to approve.
